snip.t: CT scan is useful to better define renal masses and cysts usually noted on ultrasound.

CT urography (CT with an excretory phase): the investigation of choice for upper tract evaluation in high-risk patients and for visible haematuria (renal masses, stones, urothelial tumours, filling defects).
Active surveillance for small renal masses (under 3 to 4 cm) that grow slowly, in elderly or unfit patients.
